claim: Core_Monthly_Traffic_GB = DAU × Avg_Requests_Per_User × 30 × Avg_Object_Size_GB × Core_Traffic_Ratio，代入已知 DAU=500万，假设 Avg_Requests_Per_User=20, Avg_Object_Size_GB=0.05GB (50MB), Core_Traffic_Ratio=0.7 (核心区域占比)，计算得 Core_Monthly_Traffic_GB ≈ 5,000,000 × 20 × 30 × 0.05 × 0.7 = 10,500,000 GB (10.5 PB)。
